# Level Best Remodeling

> Bathroom remodeling and home repair contractor serving Coral Gables, Pinecrest, South Miami, Coconut Grove, Palmetto Bay and Kendall, Florida. One crew, free written quote, English and Spanish. Phone and WhatsApp: (305) 753-7968. We do not do plumbing work.

Level Best Remodeling / Remodelación y reparaciones del hogar. Servicio en inglés y español. Cotización gratis por escrito.

## Services
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/bathroom-remodeling): A bathroom remodel touches walls, floors, tile and finishes all at once. One crew does the work, so you deal with one team from the first measurement to the final walkthrough.
- [Painting](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/painting): Good paint starts with good prep. We patch, sand and mask first, so the finish looks clean and lasts.
- [Walls & drywall](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/wall-and-drywall-repair): Holes, cracks and dents should not be the first thing you see in a room. We repair the wall and finish it so it blends in.
- [Doors & trim](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/doors-and-trim): A door that sticks or a missing baseboard makes a whole room look unfinished. We replace, adjust and install doors and trim.
- [Floors](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/floors): Sometimes the problem is under the floor. We rebuild damaged subfloors from the base and install the new floor on top.

## Service areas
- [Coral Gables](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/coral-gables): Permits in Coral Gables go through the City of Coral Gables.
- [South Miami](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/south-miami): Permits in South Miami go through the City of South Miami.
- [Pinecrest](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/pinecrest): Permits in Pinecrest go through the Village of Pinecrest.
- [Coconut Grove](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/coconut-grove): Coconut Grove is part of the City of Miami, so permits go through the City of Miami.
- [Kendall](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/kendall): Most of Kendall is unincorporated Miami-Dade County, so permits usually go through the county.
- [Palmetto Bay](https://levelbestremodeling.github.io/palmetto-bay): Permits in Palmetto Bay go through the Village of Palmetto Bay.
